gate.title: When were you born?
gate.body: ReelTale is for adults. You must be 18 or older.
gate.confirmBody: You were born on {{date}}. We can’t change it later.

errors.invalid_format: Enter your date of birth as day, month and year.
errors.invalid_date: That date doesn’t exist. Check it and try again.
errors.too_old: Check the year. We can’t use dates before 1900.
errors.in_future: That date is in the future.

blocked.title: You can’t use ReelTale yet
blocked.body: ReelTale is only for adults 18 and older, so we can’t open your account. Your account and data are being deleted.

adultsOnlyLong: ReelTale is for adults aged 18 and older.
